_comment: Hand-written acronyms of well-known venues for the tier lookups (src/shortlisting/tiers/venues.py). 'journals': acronym -> journal title as written in the SCImago list. 'conference_aliases': other spellings of a conference acronym -> the acronym used in the ICORE list (the ICORE file itself supplies its own acronyms). An acronym is only read as a standalone token with at least two capital letters. A small editable seed, not a ranking.
